# Unknown --opt flags surface an error instead of being silently ignored.
# (Issue #57.)

! sngl compile --opt port=8080 --out=out app.sngl
stderr 'unknown --opt "port"'

# An opt that exists on at least one of the source-declared targets is
# accepted; targets that don't declare it silently skip applying it.
sngl compile --opt listen=127.0.0.1:9000 --out=out app.sngl

-- app.sngl --
output {
    none { html }
}

component main {
    text(value="hi")
}
